format.note: 10 clubs, four meetings each; 2026-27 is the first 10-club season since 2019-20 (12 clubs and 33 rounds from 2020-21 to 2025-26). The 36 is derived from the club count and the 2019-20 precedent, not quoted for 2026-27.

playoff.note: 8th plays the 2. MFL promotion play-off winner for the last top-flight place; 9th and 10th are relegated directly. In 2026-27 that opponent is the 3rd-placed club of the single 14-club Second League. Legs not stated in the sources.

conflicts.real: the league article still says the opponent is the winner of a tie between the two Second League group runners-up
conflicts.note: Outdated: the Second League has been a single division since 2021-22 and its 2026-27 table marks 3rd place as the play-off entrant. Use 1. MFL 8th v 2. MFL 3rd.

notes: Only one Macedonian row in our list, so the league is closed in both directions in the data while in reality 9th and 10th go down and 8th risks a play-off. Size 10 and level 1 are confirmed; the 2026-27 season is the first with 10 clubs since 2019-20, which is why five clubs were relegated in 2025-26. The 36-round figure is inferred (10 clubs x 4 meetings = 36; 2019-20, the last 10-club season, played 36). The Second League (tier 2) is a single 14-club division in 2026-27: 1st and 2nd promoted, 3rd into the play-off against the 1. MFL 8th.
